mistakes.root_cause: Multi-pair MACD bots (M200200, M200100) continued trading on FTMO account during REDUCE risk state, accumulating -$356 combined losses in a single day. USDJPY positions (M0) closed by FTMO risk desk for additional -$436.
mistakes.fix: Kill multi-pair bots on FTMO account until risk state returns to GREEN. These bots were designed for unlimited demo, not FTMO challenge with 10% max DD.
mistakes.prevention_rule: When risk state is REDUCE and drawdown > 8%, ALL bots on FTMO account must be paused — not just switched strategies.

mistakes.root_cause: Propfirm Pass bot (M780012) ran once at 15:29 UTC, synced state from other bots' trades (found 9 actual trades), immediately hit daily max limit, and went to sleep without ever placing a trade with its own magic number. State sync function does not filter by magic.
mistakes.fix: State sync in sync_state_from_mt5() already filters by MAGIC and SYMBOL — but the log message 'found 9 trades' suggests it may have read trades from other bots incorrectly. Root cause: the bot ran at 15:29 UTC, which is past the 13:00-15:00 US Open window (session ends at 15:00). The 'Max trades per day' trigger at startup means a stale state file from a previous run persisted trade counts.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Verify the bot actually trades on its own magic number before reporting execution success.

mistakes.root_cause: USDJPY trades (magic 0, likely FTMO manual closure or orphan bot trades) lost -$455 today with CLOSED_BY_FTMO comment — FTMO's risk desk is actively intervening on this account.
mistakes.fix: Emergency: reduce exposure immediately. Account at 8.6% drawdown — only 1.4% from FTMO 10% liquidation.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Monitor FTMO account drawdown in real-time. At 8% DD, auto-pause ALL trading. At 9%, send emergency alert.

mistakes.root_cause: 8.5 lots of USDJPY (5.0+2.5+1.0 at magic 0) opened at 19:10-19:17 UTC, closed by FTMO risk desk at 19:32 UTC. Only 15-22 minutes of holding time. FTMO static drawdown reached 9.23%.
mistakes.fix: Emergency stop must trigger at 8% static DD (not 8% trailing DD). The risk supervisor's REDUCE state used trailing DD (8.6%) while FTMO uses static DD (9.23%) — leaving only 0.77% headroom with no emergency stop.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Risk supervisor must track BOTH trailing and static drawdown. Emergency stop triggers at 8% STATIC DD (relative to initial FTMO balance), not 8% trailing DD.

mistakes.root_cause: PropFirm Pass v8 bot (M780012) ran at 15:58 UTC on Saturday Jun 27, detected weekend, created stale PID lock (16408), entered 190879s sleep.
mistakes.fix: Bot launch script must check and clean stale PID locks before attempting to acquire new lock.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Bot launch script must check and clean stale PID locks before attempting to acquire new lock.

mistakes.root_cause: 7-day review of FTMO account: 106 trades, -$860.11 PnL. MACD multi-pair bots (M200100/M200200) went 0-for-23 trades with 0% WR and -$356 combined PnL. Propfirm pass variant bots (M780003-M780008) collectively: 36 trades, -$100.76, 15.3% WR.
mistakes.fix: Stop all non-performing bots on this account. Only Gold Phoenix showed positive returns.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Any bot with <30% WR over 10+ consecutive trades on the FTMO account should auto-disable.

mistakes.root_cause: Propfirm Pass v8 bot (M780012) has NEVER traded — 0 deals across entire lifecycle. 3 launch attempts (Jun 25, 27, 30) all failed. Jun 30: (-10001, 'IPC send failed') — wrong-account rejection disguised as IPC failure.
mistakes.fix: Terminal must be manually logged into FTMO-Demo before the bot can connect. mt5.initialize() with different credentials cannot switch accounts on a running terminal.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Before deploying a bot to a specific broker account, verify the MT5 terminal is logged into that account.

mistakes.root_cause: Risk supervisor risk_peak.json has peak_balance=$100,000 instead of FTMO starting balance of $10,000. Causes 90.92% false drawdown and permanent EMERGENCY state since Jul 1 01:30 UTC.
mistakes.fix: Reset risk_peak.json peak_balance to $10,000 (the actual FTMO challenge starting balance).
mistakes.prevention_rule: After any account switch, reset risk_peak.json to the new account's starting balance.

mistakes.root_cause: Propfirm Pass v8 bot (M780012) 4th launch. Config login=1513845007 vs connected account=1513767391 (same server FTMO-Demo, different login). mt5.initialize() returned True but silently kept running terminal's account. Zero trades across all 4 launches.
mistakes.fix: Add post-connect account_info() verification. Terminal must be manually logged into correct FTMO-Demo account.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Always verify mt5.account_info().login matches config login after initialize returns True.

mistakes.root_cause: No trend filter or cooldown between trades. Bot entered BUY just 3 minutes after closing a winning SELL TP (Trade 3). The opposite-direction entry with zero cooldown went against the prevailing EURUSD downtrend.
mistakes.fix: Add cooldown timer (30 min) after any trade close before opening opposite-direction trades. Add session-level trend bias check.
mistakes.prevention_rule: After a TP hit, wait 30 minutes before any new entry. If the last closed trade won in direction X, do not enter direction Y for 60 minutes.

mistakes.root_cause: Repeated counter-trade bias. After losing a BUY (Trade 4) and seeing EURUSD continue lower, bot opened ANOTHER BUY. No mechanism to detect 'this direction is failing today, stop entering it.' Volume was larger (8.52→8.43 lots) on the second attempt.
mistakes.fix: Add direction-failure detection: if a trade in direction X loses and price continues beyond exit, do not open another trade in direction X for 2 hours.
mistakes.prevention_rule: If a trade loses and price moves further in the same direction (beyond SL+5 pips), the bot must not re-enter that direction for the rest of the session.

mistakes.root_cause: 4 trades on EURUSD with magic 780012: 2 SL hits (-$1,041.25, -$1,030.00) and 2 breakeven closes. 0% WR. Risk per trade at ~1% ($1,245) is double the FTMO-optimized 0.5%. Three duplicate bot instances were running simultaneously, potentially conflicting on trading decisions. Trades appeared outside the declared 13:00-15:00 UTC session window.
mistakes.fix: Reduce RISK_PCT to 0.5% (target ~3.3 lots EURUSD). Kill duplicate instances. Fix launch script to prevent accumulation. Verify session window logic.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Monitor active bot process count before each cron launch. If 1+ instance exists, kill all before starting fresh.

mistakes.root_cause: 3 propfirm_pass_bot.py instances running simultaneously (PIDs 15596, 5752, 19640). Cron launcher started new instance without killing prior one from 17h earlier. Lock file at C:\Hermess\bots\locks\ only covers one deployment path; Hermess-path instances have no lock protection.
mistakes.fix: Add pre-launch cleanup: kill ALL matching instances before starting new one. Ensure lock file works across both deployment paths (C:\Trading and C:\Hermess).
mistakes.prevention_rule: Before launching propfirm_pass_bot.py, kill all existing instances matching the script name.

mistakes.root_cause: M780012 placed 6 trades over 3 days with 0% WR and -$3,081.85 PnL. 5 of 6 trades executed OUTSIDE the declared 13:00-15:00 UTC session window (at 12:26, 16:41, 17:44, 16:06, 19:24 UTC). Only 1 trade (13:34 UTC) was within window. The session detection bug causes the bot to trade in hours when liquidity is low and the VWAP mean reversion signal quality degrades. Risk per trade at ~$1,000 (1.04% on $96K account) is double the FTMO-optimized 0.5%. 3 duplicate bot instances running concurrently.
mistakes.fix: 1) Kill 2 of 3 duplicate bot instances. 2) Add pre-launch cleanup to launcher cron. 3) Fix session window detection to use UTC time, not local. 4) Reduce RISK_PCT to 0.5% (target ~4 lots). 5) Implement cooldown timer and session trend filter from Jul 13 post-trade critique.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Verify trade timestamps against declared session window after every trading day. Any trade outside the window signals a timezone bug.

mistakes.root_cause: SL hit at 15:15 UTC — just 15 min AFTER the declared 13-15 UTC session window closed. Entry was within window (13:58 UTC) but exit SL triggered after the window ended. Holding 77 min. Volume 8.10 lots = 1.03% risk on $95K balance.
mistakes.fix: Fix session window detection to use UTC time, not local time, so that trades are only placed within the declared window. Reduce position size from 8+ lots to ~4 lots for 0.5% risk.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Verify EVERY trade's entry AND exit UTC hour against the 13-15 UTC session window. Any trade with entry or exit outside the window = timezone detection bug.

mistakes.root_cause: SL hit at 17:41 UTC — 2h41m AFTER the 13-15 UTC session window closed. BOTH entry (15:25 UTC) and exit (17:41 UTC) were outside the declared window. This is the SECOND consecutive BUY loss on the same day (previous BUY also hit SL at 15:15 UTC). Counter-trade bias: bot entered BUY again after the first BUY proved unprofitable. Holding 136 min. Volume 8.02 lots = 1.04% risk.
mistakes.fix: Add direction-failure detection: if a BUY loses and price continues below the SL level, do not re-enter BUY for the rest of the session. Reduce position sizing to 0.5% risk ($500 target on $95K balance).
mistakes.prevention_rule: After a loss in direction X, block all re-entries in direction X for 2 hours. If the loss was the second consecutive in direction X, block for the rest of the session.

lessons_learned: Multi-pair bots (MACD/SMA) should NEVER be run on an FTMO challenge account.
CLOSED_BY_FTMO comment in trade history is a RED FLAG — FTMO risk desk is manually closing positions.
PropFirm Pass v8 bot (M780012) has zero trades to date across 4 launch attempts.
Risk supervisor MT5 connectivity failed for 30 hours from Jun 25 16:40 UTC — no risk monitoring during a drawdown event.
Risk supervisor uses trailing drawdown — FTMO uses STATIC drawdown. Static DD must be the primary metric.
Propfirm Pass variant bots (M780003-M780008): 36 trades at 15.3% WR, -$100.76 PnL.
Stale PID lock files accumulate between runs. Launch scripts must clean stale locks.
Risk supervisor peak_balance=$100K from prior demo must be reset to $10K for FTMO challenge.
mt5.account_info().login must be verified after every mt5.initialize() — True return does not mean correct account is connected.
Direction flip without cooldown caused -$945 loss on July 13. Entered BUY 3 min after SELL TP hit.
Counter-trade bias without failure detection caused -$1,045 second consecutive loss on July 13.
Bot instance accumulation: cron launchers start new instances without killing prior ones. 3 instances ran simultaneously for the same bot.
Risk per trade at 1% ($1,245 SL hit) is double the FTMO-optimized 0.5%. At 8.3 lots EURUSD, 3 consecutive losses hit the 4.5% daily DD cap.
State file sync is incomplete — shows 2 trades vs 4 actual MT5 history entries for same period.
Session window bug: 5 of 6 M780012 trades executed outside declared 13-15 UTC window. Bot's timezone detection is broken.
Risk per trade (~1%) on $100K FTMO account should be 0.5% ($500/target). Current $1,000/trade is double the safe level.
3 duplicate bot instances each trying to trade the same account — adds confusion, not redundancy.
Cooldown timer and session trend filter from Jul 13 critique still not implemented in deployed bot code.

July 20: 2 consecutive BUY losses (-$1,974.58 total). Both trades had entries/exits OUTSIDE the declared 13-15 UTC session window. Direction-failure detection still not implemented. Risk per trade still ~1% when FTMO-optimized target is 0.5%.
